title: SCHC clock failure leaves stale issued-sender capabilities globally registered
description: The new y4vw fail-stop cleanup clears SchcSessionManager._prepared/_records but leaves each externally referenced FragmentSender in module-global _ISSUED_MANAGERS. A terminally disabled manager can therefore retain stale issuance entries until every user handle is garbage-collected, and repeated failed manager instances can grow the global registry despite per-manager bounds. On clock-failure cleanup, atomically remove issuance entries that still point to this exact manager/sender while preserving unrelated agents/managers; add regression proving a pre-failure sender no longer resolves through the issuance registry.
